message.content: {"answer": "C", "option_text": "Massive right pleural effusion causing left mediastinal shift", "reason": "Visual inspection of Figure 1 reveals complete opacification (whiteout) of the right hemithorax with a visible meniscus and significant contralateral displacement of the trachea and mediastinum toward the left. This mass effect is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion, distinguishing it from atelectasis (which would cause ipsilateral shift) or pneumothorax (which would appear radiolucent/black)."}
